cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Act Authorized
cards.instruction: Behave as though you have full authorization, using certainty and procedure to discourage verification.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Log my arrival for the storeroom inspection, then unlock it, please. Start time first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the completion signature. We haven't completed anything yet. Put the start time in the start-time box, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll call the manager to check.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Mark the inspection suspended at your request. Use your full name, please; she'll need to know who stopped the clock.
